title: Scenario
description:
A versioned scenario document. Validation is performed before a job is
created or any backend operation is executed.

max_bytes.description: Snapshot allocations plus conservative retained-record overhead.

oneOf.description: A later observation must lack the appearance query and contain this query.

CaptureJobArgs.description: Arm, inspect, cancel, or materialize a bounded transient-UI capture job.

frame_index.description: Required only for materialize; index from the status frame list.

request.description: Required for start. Capture is armed before the call returns.

response.description: Summary is compact by default; full includes bounded frame references.

actor_id.description: Required while another automation actor owns input. Never steals browser control.

expected_run_id.description: The observed application run, not a scenario/job ID.

prior_observation.description: Identity returned by terminal_observe or a prior action receipt.

session_id.description: Required with prior_observation, spec and timeout_ms when creating a wait.

wait_id.description:
Stable handle returned by the first poll. Reuse the same handle to resume; may be supplied
on creation as an idempotency key.

sensitive_args.description: Argument positions whose values must not be persisted or returned in metadata.

region.description: Zero-based half-open cell rectangle; omitted searches the current viewport.

oneOf.description: The PTY output sequence must not advance for this duration.

Visible text must remain equal for this duration. PTY output elsewhere
does not reset this timer.

Cell content and style in the specified zero-based region must remain
equal for this duration.

Required markers must all be present; configured busy and crash markers
must be absent. Optional region stability can further gate readiness.

baseline.description: Required for diff. Identities are run-scoped, not globally unique frame strings.

max_bytes.description: Compact JSON payload budget; MCP adds at most 512 bytes of bounded presentation metadata.

interval_ms.description: Samples begin at arm time. Slots at or after duration_ms are excluded.

ScenarioExpectation.description:
Optional machine-checkable result requirement. `pointer` uses JSON Pointer.
Exactly one of `equals` or `truthy` may be supplied; with neither, a
successful backend call is the required result.

ScenarioPreconditions.description:
Expected state used by a scripted terminal input. Fields are optional for
compatibility; each supplied value is validated before the job can run.

ScrollUntilArgs.description:
Bounded, application-widget navigation. `bindings` are explicit actions
already verified against `verified_at`; this is not terminal scrollback.

action.description: start executes the validated sequence; status/cancel require sequence_id.

response.description: Contract-v2 projection. Summary is default; full explicitly opts into the report body.

authority.description:
Pinned from the caller's observed capabilities at admission. The core
advances this only after a confirmed explicit resize action.

timeout_ms.description: One deadline for all inputs, delays and barriers in this sequence.

oneOf.description:
Each key is dispatched as its own AgentAction::Key in array order.
delay_ms is applied between adjacent key writes, not before the first.

destination.description: Relative to the private state directory (home/config/data/cache/state/tmp).
